company.name: Jak Logistics
company.shortDescription: Mobile App, Logistics, On-demand, Same-day Delivery
company.description:
Jak is a disruptive on-demand delivery app and platform that speeds up the way goods are transported in cities across the Kingdom.
It connects both online and offline stores with local couriers, enabling anyone to deliver anything at any time.

Jak powers the future of urban logistics, helping both local business and large organizations move their goods through cities faster than anyone imagined!
